title: Study plan: Mechanical Engineering (CIP 14.1901)

source_refs.version: CIP 2020 to O*NET-SOC 2019 (sha256-pinned; the file states no revision date)

elements: practice scenario tasks with rubrics and reference answer outlines

agree: All 8 crosswalk links for CIP 14.1901 resolve to O*NET 31.0 occupation codes (tests check this).
Entry targets are O*NET Job Zone 4 linked occupations: Mechanical Engineers; Aerospace Engineers; Automotive Engineers.

Entry targets were changed from the rule output by a documented manual override: Mechanical Engineers is placed first as the degree's primary occupation (the rule ranked Aerospace Engineers first). Cost Estimators was replaced by Automotive Engineers, a mechanical-engineering specialty that is a more direct engineering entry role; cost estimating remains a valid alternative.
reject: Not used as entry targets (leadership, faculty, or residual titles): Architectural and Engineering Managers; Biofuels/Biodiesel Technology and Product Development Managers; Engineering Teachers, Postsecondary.
improve: Knowledge and skill importance is an unweighted mean over all linked occupations, so leadership and faculty roles still shape the top-knowledge list.
Course topics in the outline are typical US undergraduate topics written per major, not a specific institution's curriculum.
still_need_test: Practice prompts, rubrics and reference answer outlines are AI-authored and have not been piloted with learners, scored by human graders, or human-reviewed.
Regression evidence compares this build with the previous release (8cc1ce1) on links, targets, task citations and O*NET text leakage; it does not measure learning outcomes.
No sandbox, benchmark or holdout evaluation exists: this box has no independent model API key or human graders, and a self-graded run would not be independent evidence.
DreamCo-original text has not had owner review.

notes: dreamco_analysis is generated by build.py from build facts and the authored review files; it is not a human review.
